# Complete timed weekly and grouped Someday review sessions

Priority: Medium · Branch: `feature/review-sessions`

## User experience and benefit

A user pauses an Important review for a call and resumes without repeated decisions. A six-month Someday review allows postponing part of a group, keeping reflection manageable.

## Acceptance

- Resolve capped-item selection and the exact Someday interval.
- Track active review time separately from paused wall time.
- Persist session selection, decisions and progress across restarts.
- Preserve the first-three-unlimited rule and later 20-item cap.
- Support grouped Someday decisions and partial postponement.
- Connect automatic prompts after native reminders exist.
